title: useLocation
summary: Read the current path, search, and hash, plus a navigation function.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A readonly [location, navigate] tuple. navigate accepts a URL and optional { replace: true }.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: The location omits the origin. Navigation runs the destination loader and aborts superseded work. External URLs are rejected by the router; use a normal anchor or browser navigation for another origin.
